plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: One Claude Code plugin for the whole software lifecycle: an orchestrator sizes each piece of work (S/M/L) and walks it through up to 11 gated stages, from spec and design through TDD, a fresh verifier and multi-agent review to deploy and retro, plus guardrail hooks, design-system-aware UI review and setup/upgrade for any stack or monorepo.
